adaptation.changes: Specializes upstream common.rs, kes.rs, and single_kes.rs to bounded no_std Sum6KES. Removes Compact, serde, RNG, allocating and secret clone/debug APIs; adds cooperative one-leaf generation, canonical 608-byte state, and a validated BFS public tree. Uses the workspace-pinned Blake2 0.10 API without changing BLAKE2b-256 inputs or outputs.
adaptation.public_tree_layout: version 1; 127 breadth-first 32-byte nodes; children 2n+1 and 2n+2; leaves 63 through 126
adaptation.period_metadata: separate checked 0 through 63; not serialized in conventional signing state
adaptation.erasure_limit: Owned state and generation seed stack are zeroized. Primitive-internal stack/register erasure is not claimed; host secret execution requires a protected disposable lab.
